title: Driver-passenger climate separation
summary: Feedback centers mainly on the lack of separate driver and front passenger temperature controls, with a few unrelated comments about seat finish, comfort, lighting reflection, and a passenger floor mat.

positive.summary: Positive feedback only mentions comfortable seating for the driver and front passenger.

negative.summary: Negative feedback includes annoyance that driver and passenger heating cannot be adjusted independently, plus separate complaints about seat creasing and distracting mirror reflections from interior lighting.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback mostly states that the car lacks split climate or heating controls for driver and passenger sides, with one unrelated note about missing Velcro under the front passenger mat.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined statements of feature presence or absence, so the sentiment signal is limited.
The topic cluster mixes several unrelated subjects beyond climate separation, including seat wear, lighting reflection, comfort, and a passenger floor mat.
Examples are insufficient to assess broader patterns beyond the specific issues explicitly mentioned in the fragments.
